intro: Marshal Marcus Redpath is the senior military authority defending the Alliance town of Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Having served the town since before the Second War, he now organizes patrols and bounty contracts to hold off surrounding ogres, murlocs, and naga. His leadership is essential to maintaining Lordaeron's last southern bastion on the coast.

p: Marcus Redpath's service to Southshore spans decades. Years ago, before the Second War engulfed the north, he served as the village headman who received Lord Anduin Lothar, the young mage Khadgar, and thousands of exhausted refugees fleeing the sack of Stormwind. Recognizing the gravity of their plight, he dispatched his swiftest courier north to alert King Terenas Menethil II, playing an early role in forging the Grand Alliance of Lordaeron. Through the fall of the capital and the devastating Scourge invasion, Redpath remained at his post, transitioning from civil administrator to military marshal to guard the port's beleaguered survivors.

In the wake of the Third War, Southshore stands virtually alone against hostile forces pressing in from every side. Marshal Redpath coordinates defense operations across the Hillsbrad Foothills, enlisting seasoned adventurers to push back the Crushridge ogres creeping down from Alterac and purge dangerous naga and murloc encampments along the coastline. With the Forsaken occupying the north and Tarren Mill heavily fortified nearby, Redpath's vigilance is one of the few barriers preventing the regional Alliance presence from collapsing entirely.
